baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object at word 1, spreading action at word 2, praise at word 3, and agent noun at word 4 form one preparation claim.
baseline_models.mechanism: The earth is the lower plane opposite the sky; spreading converts it into leveled bedding, and the praise evaluates the agents' preparatory craft.

activation_trace.role: The lower region opposite the sky supplies the habitable lower plane.
Spreading and leveling supply the operation that makes the plane usable.
The formula of praise evaluates the quality of the preparation.
Prepared bedding and level ground supply the usable result.

changed_reading.before: The earth was made flat or broad.
changed_reading.after: The earth is intentionally converted into a leveled, usable lower plane, and the closing praise evaluates the craft of preparation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The earth and spreading action can describe living cover, while the praise and preparer noun admit animal and cradle imagery.
baseline_models.mechanism: Fertile soil sends out spreading vegetation that supports dependent grazing life; the cradle image makes the prepared earth a nursery rather than a static floor.

activation_trace.role: Fertile, growth-bearing soil supplies the productive substrate.
Vegetation spreading close to the ground supplies living cover.
Young, low livestock supply dependent animal life over that cover.
The livestock branch joins animal provision to the evaluative word.
The prepared infant cradle supplies the nursery relation.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes a static carpet for human use.
changed_reading.after: The spread earth is a fertile nursery whose cover feeds and carries dependent life.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The four focus roots can jointly describe a place furnished before its occupants arrive.
baseline_models.mechanism: A large rug and household furnishing become a congenial place already laid down as an antecedent kindness; human occupancy follows the host's provision.

activation_trace.role: The large woolen rug image literalizes the earth as laid hospitality.
Furnishing and bedding supply the host's concrete preparation.
A place agreeing with its occupant supplies congenial lodging.
A prior benefaction supplies the temporal precedence of the host's kindness.

changed_reading.before: The earth is a neutral substrate later occupied by people.
changed_reading.after: The earth is hospitality furnished in advance, so occupancy begins in received kindness rather than self-provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier wind sequence makes habitability reversible: an unproductive airflow reduces things to decay and removes bodily standing, so a spread and leveled surface is an affordance upheld rather than an intrinsic permanence.

activation_trace.role: Spreading and leveling supply the normally supportive operation.
Prepared level ground supplies the support that can be withdrawn.
Wind and moving air supply the destructive medium.
The barren-wind image removes reproductive yield from that medium.
Worn decay supplies the terminal material state of the exposed things.
Bodily standing supplies the support-affordance explicitly lost.

structural_cues: The sequence 51:41-45 moves from a barren wind through decay to inability to stand before the focus verse restores a prepared surface.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies destructive wind, decay, and lost standing; I infer that the focus ground is maintained support rather than permanent property. A live alternative is that the earlier sequence is only a punitive precedent with no qualification of 51:48.

changed_reading.before: Prepared earth is a permanently available support.
changed_reading.after: Its capacity to bear life and standing is a contingent gift that destructive force can revoke.

context_deltas.mechanism: The furnished, congenial place becomes lodging granted for enjoyment over a bounded interval, not an ownerless or permanent home.

activation_trace.role: A place that suits its occupant supplies the lodging quality.
Prepared bedding supplies the place of temporary residence.
An extended grant for enjoyment supplies occupancy as permission rather than possession.
A thing's appointed interval supplies the lodging's temporal boundary.

structural_cues: The command to enjoy until a time in 51:43 occurs inside a sequence where the granted interval ends.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enjoyable use and a bounded time; I assign that temporal limit to the focus's lodging image. A live alternative is that the limit belongs only to the cited community and does not characterize earthly habitation generally.

changed_reading.before: The prepared earth reads as a settled and durable home.
changed_reading.after: It reads as congenial lodging furnished for a granted interval.

context_deltas.mechanism: A raised canopy is assembled and widened with strength while its opposite lower plane is spread and leveled; the following joined-pair image sharpens the two operations into complementary habitat construction.

activation_trace.role: The lower counterpart to the sky supplies the second plane of the habitat.
Spreading and leveling supply the lower-plane construction operation.
What rises and overshadows supplies the upper canopy.
Joining parts into a structure supplies the canopy's assembly.
Concentrated supporting strength supplies structural capacity.
Expansion against constriction supplies the canopy's open span.
A companion joined to its counterpart supplies the relational link between upper and lower planes.

structural_cues: Verses 51:47 and 51:48 are adjacent parallel clauses with object-first sky and earth, first-person plural actions, and plural agent predicates.
The pair statement in 51:49 immediately follows the two construction clauses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an upper canopy, assembled strength, open span, a lower counterpart, and joined pairs; I infer one complementary habitat system. A live alternative is that 51:49 states a general pairing rule without specifically pairing sky and earth.

changed_reading.before: Earth-spreading is an isolated feat of terrain shaping.
changed_reading.after: It is the lower half of a coordinated, load-capable sky-earth habitat.

context_deltas.mechanism: A non-dominant mapping of the sky root contributes first rain marking soil with vegetation; joined to fertile earth, spreading plants, deliberate creation, and paired companions, the nursery becomes an upper-lower generative exchange.

activation_trace.role: Fertile soil supplies the receptive lower substrate.
Ground-hugging vegetation supplies the spreading living response.
The prepared cradle supplies the nursery function of the coupled system.
The split-target image of first rain marking earth with plants supplies an upper-to-lower germination event.
Creative origination supplies the production rather than accidental spread of life.
Joined companions supply reciprocity between canopy and fertile ground.

structural_cues: The sky clause, earth clause, and pair clause occur consecutively in 51:47-49.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a split-target first-rain mark, fertile soil, spreading plants, creation, and paired companions; I infer a rain-to-growth arrow and reciprocal ecology. Live alternatives are that the split mapping is only lexical activation and that the pair statement remains nonspecific.

changed_reading.before: The earth acts as a nursery through its own fertile surface.
changed_reading.after: Its nursery function is relational: an upper source marks the lower substrate, which answers by spreading living cover.

context_deltas.mechanism: The laid ground both permits embodied travel and invites heavy attachment; the next command reverses hospitality into traction for directed flight toward the worshiped one under warning.

activation_trace.role: Clinging and becoming heavy toward the ground supply the settlement pole to be resisted.
Traversing a path over a spread surface supplies traction and route.
Travel on foot supplies the embodied mode of departure.
Flight and escape supply urgent directional motion.
The worshiped one supplies the motion's destination.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the urgency.

structural_cues: The imperative of 51:50 follows immediately after the earth and pair statements.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a walkable spread, weight toward earth, flight, destination, and warning; I infer that the furnished ground enables rather than terminates the journey. A live alternative is that the imperative changes moral direction without recoding the physical surface.

changed_reading.before: A furnished earth is chiefly a place to settle.
changed_reading.after: It is also a departure surface whose usability gives traction for flight toward God rather than attachment to the furnishing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Preparation of an affair becomes enabling infrastructure: created occupants receive benefit through reminder and use the prepared arena for subordinated service, so comfort is instrumental rather than terminal.

activation_trace.role: Beneficent good condition supplies the occupants' received advantage.
Preparing and setting an affair in order supplies functional infrastructure.
A reminder that makes something present supplies orientation within the prepared arena.
Benefit opposed to harm locates the gain with the reminded occupants.
Creative origination supplies the occupants' prior dependence.
Submissive worship supplies the arena's stated human function.

structural_cues: The benefit statement in 51:55 is followed by the exclusive purpose construction in 51:56.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preparation, reminder, recipient benefit, creation, and worship; I infer that earthly usability serves orientation and worship. A live alternative is that purpose belongs to creatures while the earth verse remains a separate sign of power.

changed_reading.before: Earthly comfort appears to be the preparation's endpoint.
changed_reading.after: The prepared earth is an enabling platform for reminder and worship, with its comfort serving that use.

context_deltas.mechanism: The host-guest asymmetry becomes explicit: occupants do not feed the maker; apportioned sustenance comes from the provider, while gathered strength and a hard exterior underwrite the furnished ground.

activation_trace.role: Household furnishing supplies the prepared accommodation.
Gifted good condition supplies the hospitality's benefit.
Prior benefaction supplies the host's initiative before human labor.
Consumable sustenance supplies what humans cannot be furnishing to the maker.
Feeding another supplies the explicitly denied reversal of host and guest.
An apportioned gift supplies the provider's positive action.
Strength gathered like cord strands supplies independent capacity to provide.
The hard outer surface of earth supplies a material echo of provision underwritten by firmness.

structural_cues: Verses 51:57-58 negate provision and feeding from creatures, then identify the provider and strength.
The intensive provider form contrasts with the dependent occupants of the previously furnished earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied human feeding, apportioned sustenance, provider agency, gathered strength, and a hard earth-surface image; I infer that the focus furnishing is one expression of asymmetrical hosting. A live alternative is that 51:57-58 refutes divine need without specifically interpreting the earth.

changed_reading.before: Humans occupy land and produce their own provision from it.
changed_reading.after: Human production is downstream of a firm accommodation and apportioned sustenance already furnished by an independent provider.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines anatomical and sheet-material branches with cosmic construction. It remains anchored in the focus spreading verb and lower-plane noun, while adjacent support and hard-surface cues make a coherent load-bearing analogy. Render it only as an exploratory material model, not as physical cosmography.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The spreading action at word 2 can carry thin-sheet materiality while the earth at word 1 remains the lower plane.

activation_trace.role: The lower plane supplies the location of the layered surface.
Thin plates in bone or iron supply laminated materiality to the spread surface.
Ribs and supports by which a thing settles supply a load-bearing frame.
A hard outer earth-surface supplies the frame's durable exterior.

changed_reading.before: The earth is imagined only as a soft carpet-like plane.
changed_reading.after: The spread can be explored as a laminated, load-bearing surface: thin laid plates, structural supports, and a firm exterior.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins a rare bedding branch of likeness with the share and full-bucket branches of the later allotment. It remains valid as a mechanism because both return to the focus's furnishing and affair-preparation roots, while 51:59-60 supplies matching and appointment. Render it as an exploratory venue analogy, never as a lexical gloss of 51:48.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The furnishing action at word 2 and affair-preparation agent at word 4 can describe a venue readied to receive outcomes.

activation_trace.role: Laid furnishing supplies the receiving bed or venue.
Setting an affair in order supplies advance readiness for an outcome.
A share or allotted portion supplies what the prepared venue receives.
A full bucket supplies the concrete image of a measured delivery.
Matching one thing to its counterpart supplies equivalence of allotments.
The rare exemplar-as-bedding branch loops the matching relation back into the focus's furnishing image.
An appointment fixed by time or place supplies the venue's deferred activation.

changed_reading.before: The prepared bed carries only benevolent comfort.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the same prepared venue can receive matched, timed allotments, so readiness is morally non-neutral even though comfort remains the primary focus sense.

strongest_changes: The adjacent sky and earth clauses become a complementary upper-lower habitat rather than unrelated feats.
The destruction sequence makes support contingent, while the timed enjoyment cue makes habitation a granted interval.
The purpose and provision sequence turns earth from an endpoint of comfort into a service platform furnished by an independent host.
summary.what_was_special: The most productive surprises came from resolvable side branches: the sky root's non-dominant first-rain mark activated a reciprocal nursery, the firmness root supplied a hard earth surface, and the later likeness branch looped matching back into bedding.
remaining_uncertainties: The explicit pairing of sky and earth is reader-supplied; the pair statement may remain general.
The punitive scenes may contrast with prepared ground without defining its ordinary status.
The rain-mark, walking, layered-sheet, and matched-bed readings are form-distant and should remain visibly exploratory.
